query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `emotionalExpressions` (
  `id` varchar(36) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `primaryEmotion` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `emotionalIntensity` int NOT NULL,
  `emotionalTags` json,
  `description` text,
  `trigger` varchar(255),
  `context` text,
  `relatedToNova` boolean DEFAULT false,
  `previousEmotion` varchar(100),
  `emotionalShift` int,
  `isSharedWithNova` boolean DEFAULT false,
  `novaCanRespond` boolean DEFAULT true,
  `createdAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (`userId`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`)
);
